gloss: to satisfy; to fulfill; to fill

definitions.gloss: to satisfy; to fulfill; to meet
definitions.explanation: To fulfill requirements, conditions, or expectations.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{基準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たしている。
{条件|じょうけん}を{満|み}たさないと{参加|さんか}できない。
examples.english: You cannot participate unless you meet the conditions.

examples.japanese: {浴槽|よくそう}にお{湯|ゆ}を{満|み}たした。
examples.english: I filled the bathtub with hot water.

notes:
{満|み}たす is a transitive verb meaning to satisfy or fill.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: Xを{満|み}たす
- Intransitive pair: {満|み}ちる (to become full)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {条件|じょうけん}を{満|み}たす: meet conditions
- {基準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たす: meet standards
- {要件|ようけん}を{満|み}たす: fulfill requirements
- {期待|きたい}を{満|み}たす: meet expectations
- {欲求|よっきゅう}を{満|み}たす: satisfy desires

ASPECT (ている):
- {満|み}たしている: currently meets/satisfies
- {満|み}たされている: is being satisfied (passive)

RELATED:
- {満|み}ちる: to become full (intransitive)
- {満足|まんぞく}: satisfaction
- {満|み}たされる: to be satisfied (passive)
